items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against refusal of MRT cost reimbursement
items.quote: Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Schreibens bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse möglich, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The period is one month from Bekanntgabe. The letter has no date and no posting or receipt date is given, so the start cannot be fixed. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a posted letter counts as delivered on the third day after posting. The objection period would then end one month later (§ 64 SGB X, §§ 187, 188 BGB). If that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, it moves to the next working day (§ 26 SGB X, § 193 BGB). The posting date is unknown, so the due date cannot be determined. Example: if the letter was posted on 2027-05-07, it counts as delivered on 2027-05-10 and the deadline is 2027-06-10. The person should count from the postmark or the date on the envelope, and should file early.

warnings: The letter has no date, so the objection deadline cannot be calculated exactly. Use the postmark or the date on the envelope, and file the objection well before the earliest plausible end date.
The instruction says Widerspruch is possible at the Ersatzkasse in writing or on record. Send it in writing and keep proof of delivery, so the deadline is met.
